meaning: Take an occurring thought and its bearer from COGITO-SUBJECT-FROM-OCCURRENCE; the bearer exists at w by STMT-COGITO-BEARER-EXISTS-AT-WORLD. Excluded middle splits on accessibility of the bearer for existing direct support. If accessible, Acc induction descends until an ancestor has no existing supporter; the ancestry premise then makes it fail Dependent, and excluded middle splits on Substance. If not accessible, the non-accessible ancestors form an endless set, and excluded middle splits on whether a cycle lies below the bearer. Coverage only; all four non-logical premises are open, excluded middle is an explicit hypothesis, and no branch is asserted. Which case holds is not decided, and a terminus failing Substance is not thereby a process.
